Every value below is copied from text the workspace tools actually returned on 2026-10-18 and is quoted exactly; nothing is inherited from earlier sessions, nothing is inferred, and no value is filled in from memory. Two retrieval methods are used and labelled per capture: (a) 'workspace fetch_page' — the page body as returned by the fetch tool (pages that returned more chunks than were read are marked complete:false with chunk counts recorded); (b) 'workspace web_search' — the verbatim result text the search tool returned for that exact official URL, used only where the page is script-dominated or returned an empty shell on direct fetch (museemecanique.com, streetcar.org/museum, gamescapesf.com, gracecathedral.org/calendar-events, the UCSF news page). Search-snippet captures carry no HTTP status: a search result is evidence of what the tool returned, never a claim that the page was directly fetched with a 200 response. Fields with no official quotation stay blank and are reported as unverified; one explicitly paid event (Circus Bella's BRAVURA) is included with a Paid cost badge because the project asks for paid events to be collected but kept distinct from the free-first sections.
